subject: Greenline: security & deployment intake — VPC / air-gapped options
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@greenline.health>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Greenline: security & deployment intake — VPC / air-gapped options

Hi Lina,

Thanks again for the time today — great discussion. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth.

Call recap (high level)
- Greenline scope: pilot to run on non-production datasets, production will handle PHI (HIPAA applies) and EU patient data (GDPR applies).
- Compliance posture: SOC 2 Type II report is currently in progress (you said target Q4 2027).
- Deployment preferences: pilot preferred on a private VPC deployment (Redwood Private) for isolation; long-term direction possibly air-gapped on-prem for production.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Start the vendor security questionnaire (attached): I’ve attached a draft Redwood vendor intake questionnaire to accelerate answers. Can you confirm a point person on your side to complete it? (stated in the call: security@greenline.health).
2) SOC 2 timeline: please confirm the expected audit completion date and whether interim Type I evidence is available.
3) PHI & data flow: confirm whether PHI will be present during the pilot (we should treat the pilot as PHI-free if possible to shorten timelines).
4) Network requirements: outline desired isolation level — pilot VPC peering vs fully air-gapped on-prem. If air-gap, we’ll need details on physical provisioning, airlock transfer process, and allowed maintenance windows.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_questionnaire_v0.1.pdf (draft, questionnaire + suggested evidence list)

Proposed cadence:
- Monday/Tuesday next week: 30–45m workshop with your security & infra lead to walk the questionnaire and map evidence.

I’ll loop Ben (security engineering) and Karthik (solutions) on architecting the pilot options and artifacts.

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134
Redwood Inference
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@greenline.health>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: security@greenline.health
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenline: security & deployment intake — VPC / air-gapped options

Monica — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick answers from our side:

- SOC 2 status: we are mid-way through a Type II engagement; expecting report Q4 2027. We do have an interim control attestation and a summary of current scope — I’ve attached a short internal summary for context.
- GDPR/HIPAA: HIPAA applies for production environments (we do process PHI). For pilot we will try to use synthetic/ de-identified data to avoid PHI in early stages. GDPR applies for EU patient records; where relevant we will need data processing addenda.
- Air-gapped preference: long-term production we prefer an air-gapped on-prem model. For the proof-of-concept, we are open to a private VPC with strict network controls (no public egress except via approved NATs).

Questions from our infra team:
1) What is the minimal set of network ports and outbound endpoints required for Redwood Private (pilot)?
2) For an air-gapped install, what artifacts do you need to support image/hardware provisioning and offline updates?
3) Can you provide a sample network diagram and a short runbook for maintenance windows?

I’m looping our security mailbox — we’ll nominate a point person to complete the questionnaire early next week.

Attachments: greenline_internal_compliance_summary.pdf (internal only)

Best,
Lina Torres
Senior Platform Manager
Greenline Health
lina.torres@greenline.health
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: ben.carter@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Greenline: security & deployment intake — VPC / air-gapped options

Ben / Karthik — forwarding Lina’s reply and the summary she attached. Notes and asks for internal alignment: 

- Lina confirmed SOC 2 Type II target Q4 and that production will require HIPAA controls. Pilot should ideally avoid PHI but may use de-identified data.
- Greenline stated long-term air-gapped on-prem preference; pilot to start in Private VPC.

Action items (owner suggestions):
- Ben: can you take point on the vendor questionnaire? Start with the attached draft, and create a short evidence checklist. We’ll need to indicate what we can provide immediately (SOC artifacts, network docs) vs what will be delivered later.
- Karthik: please draft two architecture sketches: (A) private VPC pilot topology (expected ports, NAT/egress controls, KMS integration notes) and (B) high-level air-gapped deployment runbook (image transfer, maintenance windows, HSM/KMS considerations). Include expected timelines for each.
- Monica: I’ll schedule the working session with Greenline security for next Tue/Wed.

I also uploaded a short snapshot of their requirements to our shared folder for reference.

Attachment: greenline_requirements_snapshot.txt (internal quick notes)

Thanks — let me know if you want me to include anyone from infra or product in the working session.

—Monica
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lina Torres <lina.torres@greenline.health>
Cc: security@greenline.health
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenline: security & deployment intake — VPC / air-gapped options

Thanks everyone — quick update and initial artifacts attached.

Attached:
- redwood_network_options_diagram_v1.pdf (pilot VPC topology + air-gap appendix)
- vendor_questionnaire_filled_initial.pdf (initial pass — I’ve left flagged items where we need legal or product confirmation)

Next steps:
- I’ll host the intake workshop on Wednesday, May 26 at 10:00 AM PT (30m). Lina / Greenline security: can you confirm availability?
- Karthik: please post the two architecture sketches to the shared Drive folder and add an implementation notes page for the air-gap runbook.
- Monica: once Greenline confirms the workshop, I’ll walk through the questionnaire and list the immediate evidence items we can produce (SOC interim attestation, control matrix, network diagrams).

Thanks — short turnaround on the workshop will help keep SOC/data gating from delaying the pilot.

Ben Carter
Security Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199
